scope: First GeoStep evaluation on the source manifest official test split; freeze before opening test images

exclusions_before_model_outputs: exact resized pixel duplicate of prepared train/dev/eval or an earlier official-test image

metrics: LPIPS Squeeze v0.1 on full composed image
sample PSNR on missing region after mapping to [0,1]
aggregation: average mask pairs and FM noise per image, equal geometry weighting for overall; each seed separately and equal two-seed image means
uncertainty: 10000 paired original-image bootstrap resamples; no claim of training-seed population confidence intervals
success_reporting: all positive and negative changes reported, no minimum effect threshold; no retuning or extra training triggered by test outcomes
limitations: common-support subset, not unconditional whole-test performance

inference cost differs Regression1 vs FM8
